summary: The MCP buyer conformance gate can fire for every tool it walks: shop-scoped fixtures that pass the report filters, per-tool gated-flag probes, per-probe lookup re-seeding, an opt-in arm that requires each tool to emit a sentinel or carry a nonBuyerReading reason, guard-attributed teach refusals, floors for both modes, and a binary test that the MCP-start purge runs after flag parsing. Round 9: the seed also holds sentinels in the learn tables (CLI-taught buyer learnings, candidates, a playbook, teach.log warnings, a taught buyer lookup and pattern); every nonBuyerReading entry names what its tool reads; learnings_list/candidates/confirm/reject and playbook_list must fire; each learnings_list probe must fire; MCP binary runs are bounded by a CommandContext.
reason: With the opt-in on only sql, search and recall emitted a sentinel, so a green default arm proved nothing for the other 37 tools and per-tool guard removals (orders unshipped --full, the entity_lookups view filter) stayed green.
